title: Contract Pricing Agreement Reviewed Escalation: Shipped Volume Reduction
content:
**Shipped volume reduction on a reviewed escalation — Contract Pricing Agreement**

The volume reduction follows the units of the claimed item shipped to the customer's ship-tos less than 12 whole months before the handling date, as the shipments on the customer's Ship-To Fulfillment Account records show them. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is earlier than the earlier date's.

| Units shipped in the window | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 1000 or more | 1.0 percentage point |
| At least 400 and fewer than 1000 | 0.5 percentage point |
| Fewer than 400 | Nothing taken off |

The points are taken off the reviewed escalation allowance — the lesser of the reviewed escalation increase and the tier's annual escalation cap — before the escalation line's prior unit price is raised by it, and the allowance never falls below 0.

Hypothetical example: 650 units shipped and an allowance of 3.5 percent before reduction: 0.5 point off, leaving 3.0 percent.
